title: Akira Anime Film's 4K Re-Release Opens With US$3.1 Million in U.S.
content: Box Office Mojo reported that the re-release of Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's Akira anime film has earned an estimated US$3,175,000 during its opening holiday weekend from Friday to Monday (Labor Day).
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Dark Action Hit Confirms Major Change to Fan-Favorite Ahead of Season 2
content: One of the major breaking hits from Crunchyroll has confirmed it’s going to be making a big change to one of its fan favorite characters ahead of its return for Season 2. There were a ton of new anime releases that really took over the world when they made their debut with Crunchyroll last year, but one of them…
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Artist Shin'ichi Abe Dies at 76
content: Musician Kōsei Abe announced on Sunday that his father, manga artist Shin'ichi Abe , had died on September 4 from submandibular gland cancer. The family held a private funeral with close family members. He was 76. Abe began his career in 1970 with the Yasashii Hito manga and was active through the '70s.
author: ANN

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Dragon and Flower, 'I Was Sacrificed to a Vampire, But He Spoils Me Instead!' 1 More Manga
content: Manga UP! Global added Mio Watanabe 's Dragon and Flower: The Timid Princess and the Ice Sword's Loyalty ( Ryū to Hana: Yowamushi-hime ni Hyōken no Chūsei ) manga on Saturday, author Aira Yao and artist Asana Haine 's I Was Sacrificed to a Vampire, But He Spoils Me Instead!
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Director Reveals New Look at Jinwoo Ahead of New Movie
content: Solo Leveling is now hard at work on a new movie heading to the big screen, and the director behind the franchise has returned with a cool new look at Sung Jinwoo while we wait on the anime’s theatrical debut.
author: ComicBook

title: Naoki Azuma Launches New Glitch Witch Manga Set in Ghost in the Shell World
content: Naoki Azuma ( Keishichō Zōshi , Dragon & Ape ) launched on Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website on Wednesday a new manga titled GLITCH WITCH set in the world of Masamune Shirow 's Ghost in the Shell . Shirow is credited for the original concept. New chapters will update every other Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Junket Bank TV Anime's Premiere Delayed from October
content: The anime was originally scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo on October 5 at 12:00 a.m. JST (effectively, October 6). The story takes place in a world where banks serve as gambling halls.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Teases New Reveals for The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover & More for NYCC 2026
content: Crunchyroll has also a huge slate of plans for the upcoming New York Comic Con 2026 this Fall, and they are teasing some new reveals for hits like The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: 29 Years Later, South Park Just Changed Its Name Ahead of New Season Premiere
content: South Park has undergone a surprise name change after 29 long years ahead of what is likely going to be a very wild season with Comedy Central. South Park made its full return to TV last year after some back and forth with Paramount over a new license deal for the franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Broadcast of 'Junket Bank' Postponed
content: The official website of the Junket Bank anime series announced on Tuesday that the broadcast has been postponed indefinitely. The anime series adapted from Ikkou Tanaka 's Junket Bank gambling thriller manga was originally planned to premiere October 2026. A new broadcast date has yet to be announced.
author: MyAnimeList
